items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: I was trying to remember who played drums for Doc if I'm not mistaken I think Pat Quinn played some drums for Doc now whether he was his regular drummer I don't know

ctx.x: Doc was a drummer however Doc didn't always play he hired a drummer to be on the stand whenever he wanted to get off and I was trying to remember who played drums for Doc if I'm not mistaken I think Pat Quinn played some drums for Doc now whether he was his regular drummer I don't know
did you ever know Sidney Aroden by the time? never heard of him
